summary: Phase 41 Session 3.A — Business Radio pages backend + frontend tested. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass (business draft creation, owner profile update preserving admin-managed fields, logo/cover upload incl. 2MB limit + bad-MIME 400, non-owner 403, non-admin verify 403, admin verify flip-on/off, by-slug redaction matrix verified across verified/unverified × anon/listener/owner, discover ?filter=business|personal, 4 new OpenAPI routes present). Frontend: Wizard Step 0 chooser renders with both personal/business cards. Business path advances to Step 1 of 8 with BUSINESS chip. Verified station /r/s3a-smoke-karak shows VERIFIED chip in header, business-info-card with data-verified=true, cafe category pill, open-now badge, Google Maps deep link, tel: phone link (+971501234567), website. Unverified /r/s3a-unverified-bar shows PENDING VERIFICATION chip, data-verified=false; phone visible to owner, hidden to demo non-owner. Community /community shows All/Personal/Business filter chips; Business filter renders 2 verified station cards.

issues: Header reads 'Step 0 of 6' before page-type chosen but jumps to 'Step 1 of 8' on Business — minor copy inconsistency (6 reflects personal-only flow, 8 reflects business flow). Not a bug, but consider showing '0 of 8' when Business already implied or harmonizing copy.

critical_code_review_comments: business_stations.py:259 storage_key is built with a cache-buster suffix `?v=...` which is then stripped before upload but kept conceptually — minor confusion; the cache-buster is effectively dead code since `real_key` is what's persisted and what get_signed_url is called with. Recommend removing the `?v=...` concat to reduce confusion.

Phase 41 S3.B post-reaction milestone toast was NOT end-to-end tested (would require manual station_notifications mongo insert + page reload timing). Code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/StationPage.jsx useEffect (lines 119-159 per files_of_reference) is recommended by main agent — verified the dedupe-by-notification-id and station_slug match logic exists in source. Main agent can self-verify by inserting a row and visiting page as owner.
